cues.description: Dry strained membrane and duct material: a brief irregular pull from inside the maintenance machine. Environmental material, not a footstep or damage cue.
Two small dry organic click clusters behind the infirmary wall. A source gesture to be separated by long silence in the proposed layer.
One involuntary respirator/membrane release from the actual damaged responder. No recognizable speech, repeated breath cadence, roar or attack warning is intended.
